audit.why: Chart and prose agree: Nami wins Level 1 (bubble plus W heal blunts the walk-up), Nautilus takes 2 through first item (his Q chain beats her single skillshot peel), and Nami reclaims late as her enchanter scaling and R knock-up outpace his single engage tool.
